privileged_info_for_vlm: The experiment must be located at /home/ga/PsychoPyExperiments/wcst_task.py and the conditions at /home/ga/PsychoPyExperiments/conditions/wcst_cards.csv. The CSV must contain exactly 64 rows with columns: cardID, color, shape, and number. The sorting rule sequence is Color, then Shape, then Number, switching every 6 consecutive correct trials.
